name: Apply Closet Shelf Finish (Spray)
intent: Airless or HVLP spray one finish coat on closet shelves. Rates roughly 4x brush pace. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between. Requires full masking (wall + fixtures) per SETUP applies_when gates.
doctrine: Coat 1 at 280 LF/hr, coat 2 at 360 LF/hr — 4x brush equivalents. Spray requires masking setup and teardown (handled in SETUP + CLEANUP modules via applies_when gates).
